title: Glazed Saskatoon Berry Crumble
description: A delicious dessert that combines the sweetness of saskatoon berries with the crunch of a gluten-free crumble topping.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the saskatoon berries and glazed lacquer (if using).
In a separate bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour, cold unsalted butter, granulated sugar, Malaysian cinnamon, and sea salt.
Add the dry ingredients to the berry mixture and stir until just combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a small bowl, mix together the remaining 1/4 cup of gluten-free flour and 1/4 cup of cold unsalted butter to form a crumbly mixture.
Top the berry mixture with the crumbly mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
